t: A desktop six-joint open-source robot arm for teaching robots by demonstration.
steps: Choose the DM or RS version and buy it from the Seeed Studio store, plus the matching power kit.
Clamp the base firmly to a sturdy table.
Set up a Linux computer or a Jetson as the host.
Follow the Seeed wiki getting started guide for your version.
Install LeRobot and follow its reBot B601 guide.
Remove the brltty package and set CAN to 1 Mbps as the guides suggest.
Move one joint at a time from the example script to check each motor.
Add a leader arm later to try teleoperation.
meta: Open Board. From $169. A few stores.
